scenes.title: Glossy Ivory: 1-Day or 6-month?
scenes.say: Daily or six month colored contacts? Here's how to choose EyeCandys Glossy Ivory.

scenes.title: Beige-taupe shade for dark eyes
scenes.say: Both give the same creamy beige taupe shade made for dark eyes, with no limbal ring, the same size, and powers from zero to minus eight.

scenes.title: Wear once, throw away
scenes.say: The one day version is twenty nine dollars for ten lenses. That's five wears, with no cleaning and no case.

scenes.title: One pair, months of wear
bullets: Cheaper if you wear it often
scenes.say: The six month pair is thirty five dollars. You clean and store it after every wear, but it costs far less if you wear color often.

scenes.title: Get a prescription first
bullets: EyeCandys asks for an Rx on US orders
scenes.say: Heads up. Colored contacts are medical devices, so get an eye exam first. EyeCandys asks for a prescription on US orders, and standard shipping takes two to three weeks.
